name: Zebadiah
overview: Zebadiah was a male member of the tribe of Levi, specifically noted as the third-born son of Meshelemiah (also known as Shallum). His role or activities are not detailed beyond his lineage, highlighting his place within the Levitical family structure as recorded in 1 Chronicles 26:2.
namesAndTitles: The name Zebadiah means 'YHWH bestows,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning tied to God's provision. This proper name, while not given directly by God, carries the significance of divine blessing as understood in the Hebrew context.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Zebadiah explicitly as the son of Shallum (Meshelemiah). No other family relationships are recorded beyond this paternal connection in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Zebadiah's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Levi, emphasizing the continuity of Levitical service and heritage. As the third-born son of Meshelemiah, he represents a link in the priestly or temple-related lineage, underscoring the importance of family lines in maintaining the religious duties prescribed by God.
